content: RSA jamming limit for equal hard disks in 2D is theta=0.547+-0.002 (Feder 1980; Wikipedia RSA). Approach to jamming is slow (t^-1/2). Verified locally: rejection placement in TP4 circle (R=0.51,r=0.0175, obstacles at x0=r) saturates at N~435 with 1e5 attempts/particle; TP3 tp3 binary fails at N=460 (placed 444).
